hero.eyebrow: Intelligent Operations · Lead use case: AI Call Center
hero.subtitle: A horizontal platform where a team of governed AI agents works on one live customer context. We lead with the AI Call Center: Arabic and English, voice and chat, 24x7.

challenge.title: Three moments in the customer journey
challenge.body: The AI Call Center is the contact center product of the platform, hosted in-Kingdom and delivered by ADP. It covers three moments: routine inbound calls, complex calls handled by a person, and the follow-up once a ticket is resolved.
points: High-volume, well-defined calls: bookings, resets, FAQs and transactions
Complex calls, where the live agent needs knowledge and suggested replies
Resolved tickets that need the fix and the customer's satisfaction confirmed

opportunity.title: Land and expand
opportunity.body: Start with the AI Call Center, then add sales, marketing and sector agents on the same platform, data and guardrails. Adding a vertical is domain logic and integrations, not a new build. Saudi conversational AI is forecast to grow at a 29.8% CAGR to 2034, from USD 159M in 2025.

capabilities.title: AI Call Center Agent
capabilities.body: Inbound, fully autonomous. Handles the full call end to end: bookings, resets, FAQs and transactions. Best for high-volume, well-defined calls.

capabilities.title: AI Call Center Assistant
capabilities.body: Inbound, human co-pilot. Works alongside the live agent, surfaces knowledge, suggests replies and auto-fills CRM notes.

capabilities.title: AI Call-Out Agent
capabilities.body: Outbound, proactive. Calls once the ticket is resolved, confirms the fix and satisfaction, and reopens or escalates if not fixed.

capabilities.title: Experience and channels
capabilities.body: Web, WhatsApp, voice, email and in-app.

capabilities.title: Agent runtime and orchestration
capabilities.body: Planning, memory, tool use and guardrails: one runtime, shared memory and set of guardrails under every vertical.

capabilities.title: Data and integration fabric
capabilities.body: One live record across every system, with 50+ integrations.

capabilities.title: Sovereign GPU infrastructure
capabilities.body: In-Kingdom hosting in an AI Factory or operator GPU cloud, with tenant isolation and GPU inference for voice and LLMs.

applications.title: Support: serve everyone, instantly
applications.body: Voice and chat agents resolve queries 24x7, in Arabic and English, hand over to a human when sentiment turns, and a call-out agent confirms every resolved ticket.

applications.title: Acquisition: win the next customer
applications.body: Agents greet every visitor and guide the journey, and ads land straight in an agent conversation, for lower acquisition cost and better return on ad spend.

applications.title: Lifetime value: grow every customer
applications.body: Sales agents revive, upsell and cross-sell, and win-back campaigns run on their own, for more repeat purchases and higher lifetime value.

applications.title: Eight vertical agent products live
applications.body: Sales, SEO & GEO, marketing, reporting, call centre, retail D2C, hotel operations and lending.

applications.title: Four more verticals in build
applications.body: Insurance, logistics, healthcare and field service.

vision2030.body: The whole stack runs on sovereign GPU infrastructure in-Kingdom, either in a client's AI factory or on an operator's GPU cloud, with each client as an isolated tenant.

deployment.note: Speech recognition, LLM reasoning and voice synthesis run on GPU in-Kingdom: in a client's Sovereign AI Factory, or as AIaaS on an operator's GPU cloud. Each client has its own knowledge base, call flows and CRM integration.
